jess_cust_success: Heads-up — new customer (ACME) saw a burst of 429s right after they started traffic ramp on Android. Only in eu-west and only their mobile app. Putting logs they shared below.

raj_engineer: can you paste a sample failing request/response (headers + body) so we can see how rate-limiter categorized it?

jess_cust_success: customer pasted: ```
Request headers:
Authorization: Bearer <token masked>
X-Client-Version: android-2.4.1
X-Tenant-ID: 
Content-Type: application/json

Response 429:
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "limit": "requests_per_minute",
  "scope": "anonymous",
  "retry_after": 30
}
```

maria_sdk: :thinking_face: that empty `X-Tenant-ID` is a red flag. We shipped a bug in Android SDK v0.8.3 where on token refresh the code reused the auth fetch but dropped custom default headers when retrying. Those requests end up counted under the region's anonymous bucket.

raj_engineer: confirming server behavior: we route and meter by `X-Tenant-ID` (highest priority), then api-key, then fallback to anonymous. Anonymous bucket RPM is much lower. If intermittent header loss happens during background refresh, you can easily see spikes of anonymous 429s in eu-west.

jess_cust_success: customer says they did call `init(tenantId = "acme-71")` during app startup. They only see failures when app is resumed and token refresh triggers.

maria_sdk: repro notes: init with `tenantId: 'acme-71'`, trigger auto-refresh while request in flight. On 0.8.3 the retry created a new HttpRequest without copying `defaultHeaders`. Fixed in 0.8.5. Mitigations: 
(1) upgrade to >= 0.8.5 (recommended);
(2) explicitly attach header on every call `setDefaultHeader('X-Tenant-ID','acme-71')` as temporary;
(3) we can add a temporary server-side exception.

raj_engineer: @ops_oncall can we do a short tenant-level override for acme-71 in eu-west while they upgrade?

ops_oncall: temporary policy applied: tenant `acme-71` whitelisted for eu-west for 15 minutes (override id=6081). Watching region counters and logs now. :white_check_mark:

jess_cust_success: passed the upgrade instructions. ACME upgraded their Android app to SDK 0.8.5 in a staged rollout (10% -> 100%). They report 429s stopped within ~3 minutes after upgrade.

raj_engineer: I'll add an onboarding checklist note: "Verify X-Tenant-ID persists across token refresh — Android SDK >=0.8.5 required." Also adding a troubleshooting note about anonymous-bucket fallback behavior.

maria_sdk: filing SDK issue tracker entry #487: backport fix to 0.8.x branch and include regression test for header retention on retry.

jess_cust_success: ACME provided feedback that the SDK behavior was surprising; they suggested adding a warning to quickstart and log-level hint when tenant header omitted. I'll capture that in the CS ticket.

deploy-bot: no deploys impacting eu-west routing during incident window.

ops_oncall: override expired; no new 429s seen in last 20m.

jess_cust_success: follow-up (30m): ACME confirms stable, no more 429s. Closing the issue with notes to update quickstart and the onboarding checklist.
